en-US.name: Eye Rest
en-US.summary: Schedules regular eye breaks during a 90-minute screen-use session.
en-US.description: Eye Rest is a general-audience productivity tool for adults who spend extended time using a computer or other screen. It schedules a 30-second distance-viewing break after each 20-minute work period and ends after 90 minutes.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Eye Rest to start
Alexa, ask Eye Rest to cancel my session

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Enable Reminders permission. Open Eye Rest and answer yes. Confirm nine reminders are created relative to the start time. Use cancel eye rest to remove them.
